name: bchu-misoo-photobooth
description: Multiplayer browser photobooth by Bchu & Misoo

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bchu/shared && concurrently -n shared,signaling,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @bchu/shared" "npm run dev -w @bchu/signaling" "npm run dev -w @bchu/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bchu/shared && npm run build -w @bchu/signaling && npm run build -w @bchu/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bchu/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
